readout_screen.method: New bounded indexed English and Chinese queries on official sponsor/registry domains after the new cutoff; returned snippets reviewed for exact drug, NCT, population and endpoint. Previously acquired raw registry inspected again; no claim of a fresh registry HTTP fetch. One official Pfizer page follow-up disambiguated a status legend. AI source check, no human review.
readout_screen.finding: Returned material included earlier TROPION-Lung04 and references to the AVANZAR program; no exact AVANZAR TROP2-positive nonsquamous PFS decisive result identified.
readout_screen.limitations: No exhaustive absence guarantee. Indexing delays, incomplete Chinese-domain coverage, unindexed conference disclosures and truncated source presentation may hide results. Sparse hits are not evidence of failure. Any decisive exact result found before registration must exclude or withdraw the candidate.

evidence.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence
evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.
evidence.source_anchor: XML table-wrap id=tbl2, Overall Efficacy for All Patients and by Histology, nonsquamous columns; table footnotes

evidence.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.

evidence.title: 一期 DS-1062a 研究中的未确认客观缓解率
evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.

protocol.purpose: Source-corrected operational comparison across all four tracks on one asset; not an additional independent clinical replication.
protocol.selection_policy: Same two model families as the prior patent/workflow pilot; no outcome-based selection.
protocol.stage_policy: At most 8192 output tokens and 120 seconds per provider call. Single-pass uses one call; shared and cross-model systems use at most two. Actual usage shown separately; no claim of equal consumed compute.
